scope: Independent integration of every executed injector edge using declared300cc/min,0.745g/cc,900us opening delay; scheduled physical spark count replay; actual late per-cylinder trimmed discharge angles and pulses. No commanded-demand plant shortcut or fitted physical acceptance.

trim_runs.label: portable
trim_runs.source_policy: project trims before secondary multiplication and opening time; reference individual spark trims after composition and fuel trims on full pulse using percentageApprox
trim_runs.angle_acceptance: Actual ranges and differences are reported, with no fitted angle tolerance; per-cylinder ordering and nonvacuous executed edges are asserted.
